name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.26.0 (released 2026-07-09) hardens message templates against CPU denial-of-service attacks and adds configurable date/time formats in the web app. v2.25.0 introduced password reset via emailed magic links, reworked email verification to use durable single-use tokens, and fixed cryptographic RNG usage for access tokens. v2.24.0 added an optional in-memory ACL cache (`auth-access-cache`) for high-volume servers and fixed a critical case-insensitive ACL topic matching bug on SQLite. See full release notes at https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL (client), dual-licensed; see repository for details
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026 with active community contributions
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — token-based auth, ACL per topic, access cache, and role-based user management

breaking_excerpts: Fix case-insensitive ACL topic matching on SQLite: an access control rule for 'secret' no longer also matches a request for 'SECRET' — behavior change that may affect existing ACL rules.
Rework email verification to use durable, single-use, expiring magic links instead of in-memory 6-digit codes — old verification flow is removed.
Stop silently stripping spaces from passwords while typing in the web app's login, signup, and password-reset forms — passwords with leading/trailing spaces now behave differently.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful multi-platform notification library that aggregates dozens of services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone pub-sub server.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with a limited free tier and has seen reduced active development.

alternatives.name: Ntopng Alerts / Grafana Alerting
alternatives.review: Grafana Alerting is a robust alerting system tightly integrated with observability stacks but is far heavier and more complex than ntfy for simple script-based push notifications.
